findings.title: Injured, including a child, by Israeli bullets south of Khan Yunis
findings.location: Inside a school south of Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip
findings.affected_population_system: Three reported wounded Palestinians, including one child; no evidence supplied that they were students
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Medical sources at Nasser Medical Complex reported that 3 injuries, including a child, were inside a school by occupation bullets
findings.source_type: Established Palestinian news agency reporting information attributed to Nasser Medical Complex medical sources; Arabic and English WAFA editions, with derivative Jordanian coverage

bounded_discovery_context.discovery_method: Direct inspection of WAFA latest-news listing followed by reading original Arabic and English articles; Al Mamlaka follow-up repeats WAFA
bounded_discovery_context.distinction: New event involving three reported gunshot injuries near a school; not the November 15 Khan Younis isolated gunshot or Rafah strike previously logged
bounded_discovery_context.limitations: Precise time of shooting, identities, severity, whether the school was used as shelter, and independent hospital bulletin not verified; derivative reporting is not counted as independent confirmation.

coverage_notes.purpose: Supplementary recall only; production remains authoritative.
